Thanks — quick ops checklist so we don't miss anything:

1) Intake: confirm thread ID + signed authorization from customer (we need explicit consent on scope).
2) Scoped impact analysis: verify the conversation is present only in telemetry/audit indices and not archived in immutable backups; if it is in backup, flag for legal review.
3) Removal runbook: one-off deletion job + regenerate telemetry indexes; produce proof artifacts (sha256 of before/after index and filtered excerpts).
4) Post-run monitoring: verify no downstream exports contain the convo.

Evelyn, can you shepherd the Security pre-check? Markus, please standby for the deletion window (I think we should do the job early US window to minimize impact).

—Monica
